errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps colors and markers for two lines. The plot shows an orange line with square markers and a yellow/light-orange line with diamond markers. The description refers to an 'orange line with diamond markers' and a 'red line with square markers', misidentifying both the colors and the color-marker pairings for these two data series.
In the description of the blue line, it claims the AUC reaches 100% at N=10. The plot shows the peak for this line is clearly below 100%, at approximately 98.5%.

In the description of the 'orange line' (which corresponds to the yellow line with diamond markers), it states the AUC is 95% at N=10. The plot shows the value for this line at N=10 is approximately 92.5%. The line reaches 95% at N=15.
